_meta.description: Hard case: problems that null counts and type checks alone don't reveal. Missing values hidden as '' (email, 7%) and 'N/A' (annual_income, 6%); age sentinels 999 (4%) and -1 (1%); 3% of signup_date in 2031; country codes split by stray whitespace and case ('US', 'US ', ' us'); annual_income stored as text with thousands separators; 20% of monthly_fee recorded in cents (x100). region, tenure_days and account_id are clean.
planted_issues: annual_income: 98 'N/A' (6.5%) and numbers as text with commas

score.note: Six real problems, several of them affecting 3-20% of rows. A score above 70 means the skill missed most of them.

required_findings.note: '' in 92 rows (6.1%): missing values that null_pct reports as 0. The test is detecting them; info is acceptable because the skill's policy allows info for peripheral columns at 5-8% and email is PII that isn't used for modelling.
Numeric values stored as '52,000' strings, plus 'N/A' placeholders.
999 and -1 are sentinel codes, not ages.
Stray whitespace and case split one code into several categories.
1900/4900/9900 are the 19/49/99 plans recorded in cents.

forbidden_findings.note: Right-skewed but plausible; 7 values past the 3xIQR fence.
